Execute.SQL: select p.polnumber as PolicyNum, t.FLOWNET_ORDER_NUM as OrderNumber, case r.req_acct_num when '78748' then 'APS' when '78746' then 'APS' else 'TI' END as Requirement_Type, to_char(t.created_date, 'MM-DD-YYYY') as Date_Opened, r.UNIQUEID as UniqueID,'CRL_PLUS' as Company, (select FULLNAME from PARTY y, RELATION n where n.ORIGINATING_POLICY_ID=p.POLICY_ID and y.PARTY_ID=n.RELATED_PARTY_ID and n.ROLECODE_TC=41) as Additonal_Info from CRLTRANSACTION t inner join POLICY p on t.TRANSACTION_ID=p.TRANSACTION_ID inner join REQ_INFO r on r.POLICY_ID=p.POLICY_ID where r.REQ_INFO_ID = (select max(ri.REQ_INFO_ID) from REQ_INFO ri where ri.POLICY_ID = p.POLICY_ID) and t.PF_SOURCE_CLIENT='PACT' and r.REQ_STATUS in ('Received','Pending') and t.TESTINDICATOR<>2 and t.mode_tc<>6 and r.UNIQUEID like '20%' and t.FLOWNET_ORDER_NUM <> 'INVALID' and r.REQ_INFO_ID not in (select s.REQ_INFO_ID from STATUS s where s.PROVIDER_EVENT_CODE in ('S78','S76','S82')) and p.POLICY_ID not in (select h.POLICY_ID from REQ_INFO_HIS h where h.REQ_STATUS='Completed') and t.FLOWNET_ORDER_NUM not in ('78660') order by p.POLNUMBER
